items.title: Send signed code of conduct and emergency contact form
items.quote:
Please send us the signed code of conduct and your emergency contact form by
05/06/2026; we cannot confirm your room until we have both.
items.computation: The date 05/06/2026 can be read as 6 May 2026 (month/day, English style) or 5 June 2026 (day/month, German style). The letter is in English, but the sender is in Germany and uses the same format elsewhere, so I can't tell which is meant. The letter's own date, 03/03/2026, is the same in both readings and doesn't help. I use the earliest plausible reading, 6 May 2026. That is a Wednesday and not a public holiday, so no weekend adjustment applies. The alternative, 5 June 2026, is a Friday.

warnings: The deadline '05/06/2026' is ambiguous: it could mean 6 May 2026 or 5 June 2026. I used the earlier date, 6 May. Ask the Summer School Office which one is meant, and send both forms before 6 May to be safe.
